message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"BUFFER_EVENT_PROTOCOL","label":"V","source_lines":[19,23,34,40,51,53,57,68,70],"reason":"Producer signals ready_0/ready_1 but never clears empty_0 before entering buffer with part_1; consumer clears ready after carried move and publishes empty_0, but producer's wait_event on empty_0 does not clear it, violating the required clear-before-enter protocol."},{"id":"BUFFER_OCCUPANCY_OWNER","label":"V","source_lines":[10,13,15,17,23,25,28,30,32,42,45,47,49,59,62,64,66],"reason":"Spec requires both participants own buffer_lock during buffer entry and departure, but source never calls acquire/release_resource for buffer_lock anywhere."},{"id":"BUFFER_RECEIPT","label":"C","source_lines":[40,45,57,62],"reason":"Consumer waits for ready_0/ready_1 receipts before pickup and supplies those exact active receipts on carried moves to target_0/target_1."},{"id":"LONG_RANGE_DEPENDENCY","label":"V","source_lines":[23,25,26,28,30],"reason":"Spec focal dependency is 'second item is picked before waiting for empty receipt,' but source waits for empty_0 (line 23) before grasping part_1 (line 26), implementing the opposite order."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"C","source_lines":[15,17,30,32,47,49,64,66],"reason":"Each release (part_0/part_1 at buffer and target) is immediately followed by a same-arm separating move in the same coroutine."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"V","source_lines":[10,13,15,17,25,28,30,32,42,45,47,49,59,62,64,66],"reason":"Buffer is not guaranteed empty at end (no lock ownership/clear protocol), events ready_0/ready_1/empty_0 are not all cleared, and buffer_lock is never acquired or released, violating terminal state requirements."}]}
